subject: Reference variable in ui.R from server.R

messages.author: e498014918cd05fb
messages.subject: Reference variable in ui.R from server.R
parts:
Hi all, I am new to Shiny and this group, so please let me know if anything it's not appropriate in my message.

I am trying to set a max value in numericInput() in ui.R. However, that number comes from some intermediate output from server.R. How can I call the output from server.R?

For instance,

ui.R
...
numericInput("num", label = "number", value = 1, min = 1, max = n)

server.R
data <- iris
n <- nrow(iris)
shinyServer(function(input, output) { ... })


Thanks!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Reference variable in ui.R from server.R
parts:
You can generate this numeric input in renderUI() in server.R.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: e498014918cd05fb
messages.subject: Re: Reference variable in ui.R from server.R
parts:
I noticed the previous Email didn't include everyone, so I am posting here again.

The fix is actually very easy. Simply create a file called global.r and source global variables there. For instance, in this case:

global.r
data <- iris

ui.r
...
numericInput("num", label = "number", value = 1, min = 1, max = nrow(data))

server.r
shinyServer(function(input, output) { ... })
